title: Wanderlane Traveller Club Points Purchase Price List
content:
This price list states the terms on which Wanderlane Traveller Club points are bought outright. Purchase permitted records whether the member may buy points at all. The purchase price is the price in US dollars of one thousand purchased points. The annual purchase cap is the largest number of points that may be bought in one calendar year.

## The price list

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Purchase permitted | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Price (USD for one thousand points) | 35 | 32.5 | 30 | 27.5 | 25 | 22.5 |
| Annual purchase cap (points) | 60000 | 80000 | 100000 | 150000 | 200000 | 300000 |

## Notes on the list

Buying points is permitted at every tier of the Wanderlane Traveller Club, Wanderlane Blue included.

The price falls as the tier rises, from 35 for one thousand points at Wanderlane Blue through 32.5, 30, 27.5 and 25 to 22.5 at Wanderlane Ambassador, while the annual cap rises over the same range from 60000 points to 300000 points.
